name: New Discoveries Preschool Day Camp
street_address: East Orange YMCA Early Childhood Learning Center, 100 North Arlington Avenue
description_short: YMCA preschool day camp at the East Orange YMCA Early Childhood Learning Center for ages 3 to 5, with outdoor play, art, music, story time and swim time twice a week in the indoor pool. Breakfast, lunch and an afternoon snack are served daily.

fees.name: Extra camp t-shirt
fees.note: One shirt is included; extras are $10 each

refund_policy_summary: Changes are free through January 31, 2027. Full refund for cancellations by April 1, 2027; from April 2 all payments, including deposits, are forfeited, and there are no credits for absence or illness. Changes through the Welcome Center or after April 2 cost $35 per child per request. The East Orange YMCA registration fee is non-refundable.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swims twice a week in the East Orange YMCA indoor heated pool.
notes: Community (non-member) rate is $267.75 per session ($254 early bird, December 1, 2026 to January 31, 2027). Y members pay $255 ($242 early bird); membership must be bought by April 30 and kept through camp. A non-refundable 5% down payment ($12.75 per session) is due at registration and counts toward the fee. Camp runs Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.; Week 1 has limited capacity. One counselor for every six campers. Program for Parents accepted. Y for All financial assistance available.
